About the Job

**Company:**
Prox

**Role:**
Software Engineering Intern, Cloud Computing & Infrastructure

**Location:**
Remote, U.S.-based

**Compensation:**
Unpaid / School Credit, subject to school requirements

**Commitment:**
20+ hours/week (minimum)

**Duration:**
10+ weeks

**Start Date:**
ASAP

**Reports to:**
Founder & CEO

**Please do not apply directly through LinkedIn or send your application through LinkedIn DMs. Applications will only be considered when submitted by email to**
recruiting@joinprox.com
**or**
partnerships@joinprox.com
**. Full instructions are below.**

About Prox

Prox is building a better way for consumers to shop for groceries by making local pricing and savings dramatically more transparent.

We’re an early-stage consumer technology startup building tools that help shoppers compare grocery prices, discover local deals, and understand where their entire basket costs the least. We’re also building a platform that helps consumer brands connect with shoppers through product discovery, trial, and repeat purchases.

Behind these experiences are data pipelines, databases, backend services, and cloud infrastructure that need to work reliably as we grow.

We’re looking for a
**Software Engineering Intern focused on Cloud Computing & Infrastructure**
to work directly with the Founder & CEO and collaborate with our engineering team on the technical foundations of Prox.

You’ll contribute to meaningful projects involving infrastructure, deployments, data processing, monitoring, performance, and cloud costs. This role is well suited to someone interested in cloud engineering, backend architecture, DevOps, or infrastructure engineering who wants practical experience working on a real product.

What You’ll Own

Your primary objective will be simple:
**help make Prox’s infrastructure more reliable, scalable, and cost efficient.**

You’ll take ownership of clearly scoped projects, investigate technical problems, propose improvements, and work with the team to implement and validate changes.

Cloud Infrastructure & Architecture

You’ll help evaluate how our systems are organized and identify ways to improve the foundation supporting our consumer app, data platform, and tools for brands.

You’ll:

* Map existing services, infrastructure, dependencies, and data flows so the team has a clear understanding of how our systems work
* Help evaluate and improve cloud hosting, compute, storage, and service configurations
* Support containerized applications, background workers, and scheduled workloads
* Identify infrastructure bottlenecks and potential points of failure
* Compare technical approaches and explain their tradeoffs across performance, reliability, complexity, and cost
* Collaborate with the founder and engineering team on infrastructure priorities and implementation plans

Reliability, Monitoring & Performance

You’ll help us understand what is happening across our systems and make problems easier to detect, diagnose, and resolve.

This may include:

* Improving monitoring, logging, dashboards, and alerts for application services, databases, and data pipelines
* Investigating slow requests, failed jobs, timeouts, and resource constraints
* Helping improve retries, error handling, and recovery procedures
* Tracking measures such as response times, job completion rates, data freshness, and infrastructure utilization
* Measuring performance before and after changes to confirm whether an improvement worked
* Documenting recurring issues and helping address their underlying causes

Data Pipelines & Database Infrastructure

Prox depends on processing and organizing grocery pricing and product data. You’ll help improve the systems that move this data from collection to the experiences shoppers use.

You’ll:

* Support workflows for data ingestion, scraping, processing, and storage
* Help improve how background jobs are scheduled, coordinated, and monitored
* Identify ways to process large workloads without unnecessarily slowing customer-facing services
* Assist with database performance investigations, including queries, indexes, connections, and batch operations
* Help identify incomplete loads, stale data, and failed processing steps
* Work with the team to make data workflows easier to maintain and recover when something goes wrong

Deployments, Automation & Cloud Costs

You’ll help make infrastructure changes more repeatable and day-to-day operations more efficient.

This may include:

* Improving deployment pipelines, environment configuration, and development workflows
* Supporting Docker, CI/CD, and automated deployment processes
* Automating repetitive operational tasks and checks
* Reviewing resource usage and identifying opportunities to reduce unnecessary cloud spending
* Helping evaluate when workloads should scale up, scale down, or run on a schedule
* Supporting appropriate access controls, secrets management, backup procedures, and rollback planning
* Creating practical documentation, architecture diagrams, and runbooks that other team members can use

Who We’re Looking For

We’re looking for someone with
**technical curiosity, strong problem-solving skills, sound judgment, and the ability to follow through.**

You should:

* Be a current student, recent graduate, or early-career candidate with relevant coursework, projects, or practical experience
* Have an interest in cloud architecture, backend systems, DevOps, or infrastructure engineering
* Have familiarity with at least one cloud platform, such as AWS, GCP, or Azure
* Understand the basics of APIs, databases, application deployment, and how backend services work together
* Be comfortable writing code or scripts in a language such as Python, JavaScript/TypeScript, or Bash
* Be comfortable using Git, reading technical documentation, and investigating unfamiliar systems
* Approach problems methodically, test your assumptions, and explain how you reached a conclusion
* Communicate clearly about progress, blockers, technical decisions, and next steps
* Be responsive, reliable, and capable of working independently while knowing when to ask for help
* Be excited about working directly with a startup founder and contributing to an evolving product
* Be based in the United States and able to commit at least 20 hours per week

Preferred Experience

Experience with any of the following is a plus:

* AWS services for compute, storage, containers, or monitoring
* Docker and containerized applications
* GitHub Actions or other CI/CD tools
* PostgreSQL, Supabase, Redis, or related database and caching technologies
* Monitoring and logging platforms such as Grafana or CloudWatch
* Linux, networking fundamentals, and cloud permissions
* Infrastructure as code, such as Terraform or AWS CDK
* Data pipelines, background jobs, queues, or scraping infrastructure
* Performance optimization, troubleshooting, or cloud cost analysis
* Side projects, technical internships, or experience working in a startup environment

Relevant experience can come from coursework, personal projects, research, internships, or other hands-on work. You do not need experience with every tool listed.

**Being based in Southern California is cool, but it is not required.**

What Makes This Different

Infrastructure decisions affect nearly every part of a product: how quickly data becomes available, how reliably features work, how easily engineers can ship improvements, and how much it costs to operate.

At Prox, you’ll have visibility into those connections and the opportunity to contribute to decisions that shape how the company grows.

You’ll work directly with the Founder & CEO and collaborate with engineers on real technical problems. You’ll be expected to investigate issues, propose a thoughtful approach, implement scoped improvements with appropriate review, and explain the results.

You’ll also gain experience balancing the practical tradeoffs that early-stage companies face, including speed, reliability, cost, and maintainability.

For someone interested in cloud engineering, backend systems, infrastructure, or eventually building a technology company, this is an opportunity to develop technical skills alongside an understanding of how engineering decisions support a business.

Logistics

* **Start:**
  ASAP
* **Duration:**
  10+ weeks
* **Commitment:**
  20+ hours per week, with flexibility around school schedules
* **Location:**
  Remote, U.S.-based
* **Schedule:**
  Flexible, with consistent availability, responsiveness, and agreed-upon time for team collaboration
* **Reports to:**
  Founder & CEO, with collaboration across the engineering team
* **Compensation:**
  This is an unpaid internship. School credit may be available depending on your institution’s requirements.

How to Apply

**Do not apply directly through LinkedIn or through LinkedIn DMs. You must apply by email to be considered.**

Send your
**résumé and a short note**
to recruiting@joinprox.com
**or**
partnerships@joinprox.com.

**Email subject:**
Cloud Computing Internship | [Your Full Name]

In your note, please answer these two questions:

1. **Why does this opportunity interest you, and what would you like to learn or contribute at Prox?**
2. **Tell us about a cloud, backend, infrastructure, or data project you’ve worked on. What problem were you solving, what did you personally build or improve, and how did you determine whether it worked?**
   Coursework and personal projects are welcome.

Please also include your location, earliest start date, and weekly availability. If you have a GitHub profile, portfolio, or relevant project link, include it as well.

**Only applications submitted by email with both a résumé and a short note will be reviewed.**

We’re interested in how you think, solve problems, and take ownership of your work.
fit_why: Unpaid cloud/infrastructure role, leans DevOps/data-infra; partial stack overlap

Company Overview 
 At Motorola Solutions, we believe that everything starts with our people. We’re a global close-knit community, united by the relentless pursuit to help keep people safer everywhere. We build and connect technologies to help protect people, property and places. Our solutions foster the collaboration that’s critical for safer communities, safer schools, safer hospitals, safer businesses, and ultimately, safer nations. Connect with a career that matters, and help us build a safer future.
 
 Department Overview 
Our RF Site Software Engineering organization, a key component of the ASTRO Networks business segment at Motorola Solutions, consists of a diverse group of software engineers, product architects, system architects, and test engineers. We are situated across various global locations, working collaboratively to develop next-generation RF Site solutions. 

Leveraging the latest in virtualization technologies on a robust Linux platform, our team follows modern software development practices such as continuous integration/continuous deployment, DevOps, component-level and system-level automated testing. We use Agile methodologies to organize our work and we are responsible for end-to-end software development life-cycle. 
Job Description
 We are looking for a self motivated individual to help move forward the next generation public safety experience, and to work with a team of top experienced professionals to enable mission critical services and solutions. 

 In this position you will work as a software engineering intern on a project related to our landmobile wireless communications products.  In this role, you will be engaged in the full software development life cycle of the project, including design, implementation and test.  This role will involve C++ implementation on embedded products as well as the potential for some python scripting.  Your tasks will also involve hands-on interaction with product hardware and lab equipment for development, testing, and debugging. 

 Desired Skills: 
 
• Strong interpersonal, written, and verbal communication skills 
• Ability to work well in a cross-functional team environment 
• Experience with C/C++ and object oriented development 
• Understanding of real time processing in an embedded environment 
• Experience with Linux or Unix 
• Basic understanding of virtualization technologies such as Docker, Podman etc. 
• Exposure to Agile development practices 
• Experience with Git, Jira 
• Advanced debugging skills 
• Excellent organizational skills 
• Ability to work with and debug legacy code 
• Strong interpersonal, written, and verbal communication skills 
• Ability to work well in a cross -functional team environment 
Basic Requirements
 
• Candidates must be pursuing a Bachelors or Masters degree in Computer Engineering, Computer Science, or Software Engineering. 
Travel Requirements
None 
Relocation Provided
None 
Position Type
Intern 
 EEO Statement 
 
 Motorola Solutions is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion or belief, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, veteran status or any other legally-protected characteristic.  
 
 We are proud of our people-first and community-focused culture, empowering every Motorolan to be their most authentic self and to do their best work to deliver on the promise of a safer world. If you’d like to join our team but feel that you don’t quite meet all of the preferred skills, we’d still love to hear why you think you’d be a great addition to our team. 
 
 We’re committed to providing an inclusive and accessible recruiting experience for candidates with disabilities, or other physical or mental health conditions. To request an accommodation, please complete this  Reasonable Accommodations Form  so we can assist you.

At Bose Corporation, we believe sound is the most powerful force on earth — and for over 60 years, we have been a company built on innovation, excellence, and independence. Privately owned, fiercely customer-focused, and driven by our values, we continue to lead industries and transform lives through sound.  
    
 Today, Bose Corporation is entering an exciting new era. Across multiple global Business Units and Global Functions, we are shaping the future of audio technology, automotive, luxury, and premium experiences. We invite you to join us in this transformation.  

 Job Description 
 
 ABOUT BOSE CORPORATION 
 At Bose Corporation, we believe sound is the most powerful force on earth — and for over 60 years, we have been a company built on innovation, excellence, and independence. Privately owned, fiercely customer-focused, and driven by our values, we continue to lead industries and transform lives through sound. 
   
 Today, Bose Corporation is entering an exciting new era. Across multiple global Business Units and Global Functions, we are shaping the future of audio technology, automotive, luxury, and premium experiences. We invite you to join us in this transformation. 
  
 ABOUT THE CO-OP PROGRAM 

 Bose Corporation is seeking students to participate in our Co-op Program who share our belief that sound is power. During the six-month co-op, students will have the chance to apply classroom learning in a hands-on work environment. Co-op participants will network across the business to gain diverse perspectives within Bose Corporation. Additionally, co-ops will connect with other students and colleagues, building valuable professional relationships for the future.

 Fall Co-op: Candidates must be available to work full-time (40 hours per week) in a hybrid, in-office format from July 12 through December 17, 2027. No relocation assistance is available. 

 Being currently authorized to work in the U.S. is a precondition of employment for this position .

 THE ROLE 
 We're looking for a Co-op to join our research team and explore how AI agents can support engineers working on active sound management technologies.
 The role sits at the boundary between signal processing and software engineering. You don't need to be an active noise control expert on day one; you will learn the domain from senior engineers who build these tools. You should be a strong programmer who is comfortable reading engineering code and asking why it works.
 In this role, you will:
 
• Capture expert knowledge. Work with senior engineers to document engineering workflows: key decisions, heuristics, failure modes, and what a finished result looks like. 
• Modernize engineering tools. Refactor existing tools into modular functions with well-defined inputs and outputs. 
• Connect tools to AI agents. Make engineering functions available to LLM-based agents using Python and modern tool-calling interfaces. 
• Measure what works. Build an evaluation framework that compares agent results against expert-produced references. 
• Build in safeguards. Implement automated checks that keep agent outputs within engineering and safety limits. 
• Prototype and demonstrate. Build an agent-assisted workflow and demonstrate it on a real engineering use case. 
• Report and document. Present your results and document your work so the team can build on it after your term. 
 
• To excel in this role, candidates should possess the following: 
• Currently pursuing a PhD or MS in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Computer Science, Mechanical Engineering, or a related field 
• Strong Python: writing modular code, packaging functions, using git, and writing tests 
• Working knowledge of MATLAB, enough to read and refactor existing engineering scripts 
• Signal processing fundamentals: FFT, spectra, transfer functions, coherence, and digital filters 
• Hands-on experience calling an LLM API or building a simple agent or tool-using app, in a project, course, or internship 
• Clear written communication; the role involves documenting expert knowledge, not just code 
 Preferred Qualifications: 
 
• Coursework or projects in adaptive filtering, active noise control, or acoustics 
• Background in optimal filtering, multichannel systems, or control systems 
• Familiarity with Simulink 
• Experience with LLM agent frameworks, tool calling, or agent protocols such as MCP 
• Experience designing evaluations or test suites for ML or LLM systems 
• Experience integrating MATLAB and Python 
• Comfort with large measurement datasets (time series, .mat or HDF5 files) and with plotting results clearly 
• WHAT YOU WILL LEARN 
 
• How active noise cancellation systems are measured, designed, and optimized 
• How to turn expert engineering judgment into reliable, testable software 
• How to build and evaluate an LLM agent for a real engineering task where reliability matters 

At Bose, you're inspired to be and do your best and are rewarded for your unique talents! Our compensation is thoughtfully tailored to your skills, experience, education, and location, and goes beyond base salary. The hiring range for this position in the primary work location of Framingham, Massachusetts is: $40.00-$51.25 per hour.The hiring range for other Bose work locations may vary.

In addition to competitive base pay we offer rewards including bonus programs, comprehensive health and welfare benefits, a 401(k) plan, plus exclusive perks designed to support your wellbeing, and a generous employee discount where you can immerse yourself in our products and experiences. We are a proudly independent company—driven by purpose, guided by our values, and united by a belief in the power of sound. As the world leader in audio experiences, we’re creating what’s next—pushing boundaries and delivering transformative sound experiences for people everywhere. Join us and make your next career move a mic-drop. Let’s Make Waves. ‎
fit_why: Requires PhD/MS in EE/CE, DSP, MATLAB, active noise control expertise
